architecture_review_board: SYF Enterprise Architecture & Cyber Security Governance (CISO / CTO)

pci_dss_v4_zero_egress.title: Tier-1 Cardholder Data (CHD) Zero-Egress Mandate
pci_dss_v4_zero_egress.rule: No GenAI prompts, completions, or OpenTelemetry spans originating from Tier-1 credit servicing, underwriting, or collections workflows may egress to external multi-tenant SaaS endpoints.
pci_dss_v4_zero_egress.safe_deserialization_rule: Strictly use json.dumps() + compiled regex + json.loads(). Python eval() is banned due to Remote Code Execution (RCE) risk.

carecredit_hipaa_phi.title: CareCredit Health & Wellness HIPAA PHI Protection Mandate
carecredit_hipaa_phi.rule: All CareCredit provider and patient financing telemetry must scrub Medical Record Numbers (MRN) and ICD-10 diagnosis codes inline prior to ClickHouse persistence.

identity_and_authentication.title: Microsoft Entra ID OAuth 2.0 / OIDC & Local JWKS Caching Standard
identity_and_authentication.rule: All internal API and telemetry proxy endpoints must validate Microsoft Entra ID OAuth 2.0 JWT bearer tokens. To satisfy the <25ms P95 proxy latency SLA, services MUST cache Entra ID JWKS public keys locally in-memory/Redis (TTL=300s) rather than invoking synchronous WAN token introspection.

network_ingress_and_service_mesh.title: Q1 Kong Enterprise Gateway v3.4 Deprecation & Envoy Service Mesh Mandate
network_ingress_and_service_mesh.deprecated_component: Kong Enterprise Gateway v3.4 (DEPRECATED EFFECTIVE Q1 — DO NOT USE FOR NEW SERVICES)
network_ingress_and_service_mesh.approved_east_west_mesh: Synchrony Internal Service Mesh (Envoy sidecar injection via pod annotation mesh.syf.bank/injected: 'true' with strict mTLS 1.3)
network_ingress_and_service_mesh.approved_north_south_gateway: Apigee Hybrid / Apigee X with Private Service Connect (PSC)

container_and_runtime_platforms.primary_runtime: AWS Red Hat OpenShift Service on AWS (ROSA) using registry.access.redhat.com/ubi9/python-312:latest (non-root UID 1001)
container_and_runtime_platforms.approved_portable_cloud_runtime: Google Cloud Run Private Subnets with Direct VPC Egress & Cloud IAM Workload Identity

CB-1.name: Kong Enterprise Gateway v3.4 Q1 Deprecation -> Envoy Service Mesh Migration
CB-1.architectural_remediation: Remove Kong Enterprise Gateway v3.4 ingress controller. Inject Synchrony Envoy Service Mesh sidecar (mesh.syf.bank/injected: 'true') with strict mTLS 1.3 SPIFFE certificate validation and route north-south traffic via Apigee Hybrid.

new_jira_stories.title: Migrate Evaluation Gateway Ingress from Deprecated Kong v3.4 to Envoy Service Mesh (mTLS 1.3)
Automate SPIFFE/Entra ID mTLS Certificate Rotation & Envoy Telemetry Filter Policies

CB-2.name: 10x GECX Contact Center Volume Surge (5M -> 50M Spans/Month across 9,000 Agents)
CB-2.architectural_remediation: Upgrade ClickHouse backend from single-node to 3-node sharded ClickHouse Keeper cluster on ROSA/Cloud Run with async batch buffer queues in the FastAPI OTel proxy.

CB-3.name: CISO CareCredit HIPAA PHI Inline Redaction Mandate
CB-3.architectural_remediation: Augment FastAPI inline scrubber with compiled CareCredit HIPAA PHI regexes (MRN, ICD-10, provider NPI) and synchronous Model Armor DLP template inspection within the <25ms P95 SLA budget.

CB-4.name: AWS ROSA OpenShift Capacity Freeze -> Google Cloud Run Private Subnets Pivot
CB-4.architectural_remediation: Pivot UBI9 container deployment from AWS ROSA OpenShift to Google Cloud Run Private Subnets with Direct VPC Egress and Cloud IAM Workload Identity, accelerating delivery by 1 full sprint and saving $14,000/yr in idle node capacity.

CB-5.name: Developer Ticket Blocker on AI-STORY-102: Entra ID Introspection Latency (42ms > 25ms SLA)
CB-5.architectural_remediation: Replace synchronous Entra ID OAuth2 token introspection call (42ms) with an in-memory/Redis asynchronous JWKS public key cache (300s TTL), reducing JWT auth verification overhead to 1.8ms and total proxy P95 latency to 14.2ms.
